title: Food Borne Illness
description: Use this service request to report sickness from eating at any food establishment, vending machine, or school within the Dallas City limits. A name and phone number are required to process this request. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

contactStep.observedDiscrepancy: The service description says a name and phone number are required, while the contact step says contact information is optional.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for illness after eating food from a Dallas food establishment, vending machine, or school.
actions.why: For sickness after eating food from a food establishment, vending machine, or school within Dallas City limits.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Food Borne Illness"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Food Borne Illness"
